overview: ClipCraft is a free, browser-based video editor with a professional multi-track timeline, universal keyframe animation, advanced effects (shake, blur, color-shift), graph editor for bezier curves, text overlays, custom preset creator, project dashboard, auth, and MP4 export.
features: Universal keyframe animation on any property
Graph editor with bezier curves and easing presets
Shake, blur, and color-shift effects with keyframe support
Text layers with keyframe-able opacity and position
Custom effect and transition preset creator
Built-in transitions: fade, slide, zoom, blur, spin, glitch
Project dashboard with autosave and recent projects
User authentication with personal project storage
Export to MP4 in 720p/1080p/4K with aspect ratio options
Light and dark mode with persistent preference
